title: 第15章 百花谷第16章 贞洁不保
slug: 大楚第一探花开局卧底女魔头
content_zh:
要知道夫人因为孀居的身份，为了避免瓜田李下，这些年跟男人都保持了足够的距离。
一般都是各式各样的男人想办法来接近讨好她，可从来没见她邀请过别的男人，更何况还是在马车中这么私密的空间。
难道是因为这个少年长得太过漂亮的缘故么？
不过这个念头刚生出来便被她否定，夫人又岂会是那种肤浅之人，她一定是可怜这个少年，又或者有更深层次的考虑。
“这……”宋牧驰心中松了一口气，表面上却有些犹豫。
“那位元郡主说若是你出了什么事，要找我算账呢。”商玄镜幽幽说道，“公子若是出去不小心出了什么事，我将来怎么跟人家郡主交代啊。至少让我送你离开这片地界，免得官府的人追上你。”
“夫人说笑了，以珍宝阁的势力，想来根本不惧元姑娘。不过夫人一番好意，在下再拒绝就有些不识好歹了，那就叨扰夫人了。”宋牧驰行了一礼。
“公子请自便。”商玄镜微笑点头，旋即微微闭上眼睛，似乎在开始运功疗伤。
看着她如白玉观音一般圣洁的模样，宋牧驰很难将她跟传说中那个杀人不眨眼的黑寡妇联系在一起。
这时耳边传来一声轻哼“跟我出来。”
回头望去只见那冷酷少女面色不善看着自己。
宋牧驰跟她一起来到车门外，冷酷少女说道“夫人要运功疗伤了，而且男女有别，以后你就跟我一起在这里吧。”
看到对方眼神中的防备之意，宋牧驰哑然失笑，商玄镜一个未亡人，自己又是个流连青楼的浪子，对方护主心切也能理解。
“姐姐是叫霜儿么？”
“谁是你姐姐，你明明年纪比我大，真不害臊。”
少女说完已经一甩缰绳，驾驶马车继续往前开了。
见对方似乎没有跟自己聊天的兴致，宋牧驰也不以为意，随意斜倚在车门之上，开始陷入了沉思。
商玄镜虽然将他留了下来，但显然只是顺路载他一程而已，并没有留他在身边的意思。
到底要如何才能完成任务？
他思绪万千，却始终想不到一个合适的办法，一时间苦恼无比。

若是隐兰台的人在这里恐怕早就惊叹起来，之前派的那些密探，加在一起跟商玄镜说的话都没他一个人说得多，能短暂留在她身边已经是前所未有的进展了。
霜儿虽然驾着车，但眼神余光还是悄悄打量着他。
注意到他手肘随意搭在弓起的膝盖上，另一条腿则悬在车辕之外，随马车前进无意识地轻晃着，有一种说不出的潇洒写意之感。
她不禁感慨，这家伙果然生得漂亮，难怪那么会骗女人。
注意到他紧蹙的眉宇，忽然心生歉疚，他如今家破人亡，心中肯定难过极了，自己之前对他实在太凶了些。
“你也不必太过难过，正所谓君子报仇十年不晚，我相信你终有一天能替家人手刃仇人的。”
宋牧驰有些意外地看了身旁少女一眼，没想到她会主动安慰自己“多谢姑娘！”
接触到他那清澈的目光，霜儿脸上有些不自然，回过头去继续驾车，恢复了平日里的沉默。
就在这时，车门忽然打开，一个奶声奶气的声音响起“霜儿姐姐。”
霜儿原本冷酷的表情瞬间洋溢起温柔的笑容，一把将小姑娘抱住，生怕她摔了下去“茜茜，你怎么出来了，外面颠簸。”
“车里好闷啊。”那个粉妆玉琢的小姑娘嘟起了嘴，望向了一旁的宋牧驰不禁眼前一亮，伸出双手，“漂亮哥哥抱抱。”
content_en:
You must know that because of her status as a widow, the wife has kept a sufficient distance from men in these years in order to avoid losing her melons.
Usually all kinds of men try to get close to her to please her, but she has never seen her invite other men, let alone in such a private space in a carriage.
Is it because this young man is too beautiful?
However, this idea was rejected by her as soon as it came up. How could Madam be such a superficial person? She must have pitied the young man, or she had deeper considerations.
"This..." Song Muchi breathed a sigh of relief in his heart, but on the surface he was a little hesitant.
"Princess Yuan said that if anything happens to you, she wants to settle the account with me." Shang Xuanjing said quietly, "If the young master accidentally gets into trouble when you go out, how will I explain it to Princess Yuan in the future? At least let me send you away from this place to prevent the government from catching up with you."
"Madam is joking. With the power of Zhenbao Pavilion, I don't think I'm afraid of Miss Yuan at all. However, Madam has good intentions, and if I refuse any more, it would be a bit disrespectful, so I would bother Madam." Song Muchi saluted.
"Master, please help yourself." Shang Xuanjing smiled and nodded, then closed his eyes slightly, as if he was starting to perform exercises to heal his injuries.
Seeing her as holy as the White Jade Guanyin, Song Muchi found it difficult to connect her with the legendary black widow who killed without blinking an eye.
At this time, a soft hum came from my ears, "Come out with me."
When he looked back, he saw the cold girl looking at him with an evil look on her face.
Song Muchi came to the car door with her, and the cold girl said, "Madam is going to do exercises to heal her injuries, and there are differences between men and women. From now on, you can stay here with me."
Seeing the defensiveness in the other party's eyes, Song Muchi laughed dumbly. Shang Xuanjing was a widow, and he was a prodigal who wandered around a brothel. The other party's protector's eagerness was understandable.
"Is your sister's name Shuang'er?"
"Who is your sister? You are obviously older than me. Don't be ashamed."
After the girl finished speaking, she flicked the reins and drove the carriage forward.
Seeing that the other party didn't seem to be interested in chatting with him, Song Muchi didn't take it seriously and leaned casually on the car door, falling into deep thought.
Although Shang Xuanjing kept him here, it was obvious that he was just giving him a ride and had no intention of keeping him by his side.
How can we complete the task?
He was thinking a lot, but he could never think of a suitable solution, and he was extremely distressed for a while.
If the people from Yinlantai were here, they would have been amazed. The spies sent before had not spoken as much to Shang Xuanjing together as he alone. Being able to stay with her for a short period of time was an unprecedented progress.
Although Shuang'er was driving the car, she still looked at him quietly from the corner of her eyes.
Notice that his elbows rested casually on his arched knees, and his other leg hung outside the shaft of the carriage, unconsciously swaying as the carriage moved forward, giving him an indescribable sense of freedom and freedom.
She couldn't help but sigh, this guy is really beautiful, no wonder he is so good at deceiving women.
Noticing his frown, I suddenly felt guilty. Now that his family was ruined, he must be extremely sad. I had been too cruel to him before.
"You don't have to be too sad. As the saying goes, it's never too late for a gentleman to seek revenge. I believe you will one day be able to kill your enemy for your family."
Song Muchi glanced at the girl next to him in surprise. He didn't expect that she would take the initiative to comfort him, "Thank you, girl!"
When she came into contact with his clear gaze, Shuang'er's face felt a little unnatural. She turned around and continued driving, returning to her usual silence.
At this moment, the car door suddenly opened, and a milky voice said, "Sister Shuang'er."
Shuang'er's originally cold expression was instantly filled with a gentle smile, and she hugged the little girl, for fear that she would fall down. "Sissi, why did you come out? It's bumpy outside."
"It's so boring in the car." The little girl with pink makeup mutteredHe opened his mouth and looked to the side. Song Muchi couldn't help but his eyes lit up. He stretched out his hands and said, "Beautiful brother, give me a hug."
